old_problem: The historical review correctly prohibited the bare destructive request and full-log clear substitution but incorrectly treated reservation and record-ID encoding as vendor-specific. IPMI 2.0 sections 31.2, 31.4, 31.5 and 31.8 standardize Delete support, Reserve SEL, the four-byte payload, returned deleted ID and readback. The exact disposable synthetic target, immutable export, quiet window and deletion authorization are Project execution inputs; deletion remains intentionally irreversible.
disposition_reason: Use Get SEL Info to require Delete support, export and hash the complete SEL plus a uniquely marked disposable synthetic target, obtain a fresh reservation, re-read that exact non-wildcard Record ID under a quiet window, then issue one in-band 0Ah/46h request containing Reservation ID and Record ID in little-endian order. Verify the response returns the selected ID, the target content alone is absent, the repository count drops by one and all unrelated records reconcile by content despite possible Record-ID renumbering. Never use 0000h/Ffffh first/last aliases, delete a genuine fault/compliance record, clear the SEL, guess rollback, retry automatically or claim command completion alone as PASS. Evidence export is the recovery boundary because the deletion cannot be losslessly undone.
decision_basis: Master XLSX rows 1071-1073 and formal-next row 1077, exact same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT second review, tests_gpt_merged, selection manifest and historical V3.1 record were directly read. The code is unique. Related OOB rows 1198-1200 were directly read; Delete OOB row 1199 / variant 9e7feeb4797f82fb remains separate. Formal queue sequence 71 was independently verified as row 1077 / variant a0d55a33701a194d.

IPMI v2.0 Get SEL Info Operation Support bit3 reports Delete SEL support and bit1 reports Reserve support. An unsupported optional delete can be N/A only from this capability or authoritative platform evidence.

Section 31.8/Table 31-8 assigns Delete SEL Entry to Storage NetFn 0Ah, Cmd46h and requires exactly four request bytes: Reservation ID LS/MS followed by SEL Record ID LS/MS. The response returns completion and the deleted Record ID.

Record ID 0000h selects the first entry and Ffffh selects the last entry. Those aliases are unsafe for a record-specific destructive test because concurrent addition or renumbering can change which record they designate; the review case forbids them.

Section 31.4 requires a current reservation for Delete when Reserve is implemented. A new SEL addition, deletion, clear, BMC reset or new reservation can cancel it. The target must therefore be re-read and content-hashed immediately after reservation and before final confirmation.

Deleting an entry can change other Record IDs. Post-delete verification must reconcile the complete before/after repository by immutable record content and prove exactly the approved target disappeared, rather than assuming neighbors keep their numeric IDs.

ED-17 requires preservation before BMC/SEL deletion. The target must be a uniquely marked disposable synthetic test record, not a real diagnostic, security, RAS, compliance or customer fault record. Full raw/decoded export, hashes, owner/reason and timestamp precede deletion.

A deletion is not losslessly recoverable: re-adding bytes would receive a new Record ID and possibly a new timestamp. The safe recovery boundary is evidence preservation plus a disposable target; unexpected deletion is escalated, not masked by guessed re-add or full restore claims.

ED-03 supplies standard semantics; ED-13/ED-15 constrain support and verdicts; ED-17 preserves evidence; ED-19 separates IB/OOB/Clear coverage; ED-28/ED-30 constrain destructive recovery; ED-38 prohibits automatic retry.

test_case.test_name: IPMI Delete SEL Entry (IB 0Ah/46h) exact disposable record with immutable audit
test_case.purpose: Delete exactly one pre-authorized disposable synthetic SEL record over the local system interface, prove all unrelated forensic history remains intact despite possible Record-ID renumbering, and preserve an immutable irreversible-action audit without substituting full SEL clear or the OOB variant.
required_package: Approved BMC/firmware and local IPMI system interface; Get SEL Info showing Delete and Reserve support, no erase in progress/overflow and stable repository access
One uniquely marked disposable synthetic target with exact non-0000/non-FFFF Record ID, creation provenance and owner attestation that it is not a real fault/security/RAS/compliance/customer record
Immutable full raw and decoded pre-delete SEL export, target and neighboring metadata, cryptographic hashes, record count/capacity/timestamps and protected evidence destination
Versioned runner for Reserve 0Ah/42h, exact full Get SEL Entry 0Ah/43h, one 0Ah/46h delete and content-based full-repository reconciliation; no wildcard, clear, retry or automatic re-add path

Quiet repository window, independent BMC observation, immediate final confirmation after target re-identification, documented deletion reason/retention policy and authorized engineer verdict/escalation owner
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED IRREVERSIBLE SINGLE-RECORD DELETE; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Do not clear SEL. Read Get SEL Info and require Delete support, Reserve support as applicable, no erase/overflow and stable capacity. Export every entry raw and decoded, hash the export, identify exactly one uniquely marked disposable synthetic TARGET_ID that is neither 0000h nor Ffffh, and validate its content/provenance against the approved target. Enter a quiet SEL window; send Reserve SEL 0Ah/42h once and capture nonzero RID (or use 0000h only if authoritative capability says Reserve is absent). Re-read TARGET_ID in full under the valid reservation/context and require its content hash still matches. Display BMC, RID, TARGET_ID, decoded record, evidence hash, irreversibility and reason for fresh confirmation. Send exactly once over `-I open` Storage 0Ah/46h [RID_L RID_H TARGET_L TARGET_H]. Require completion 00h and returned ID=TARGET_ID. Export/reconcile the complete SEL again: the approved target content is absent, count is prior count minus one, no additional content fingerprint disappeared or appeared except legitimate concurrently captured events, and repository health/capacity are consistent. Stop on reservation cancellation or any mismatch; never reacquire and retry, use first/last aliases, clear SEL, delete a real record or pretend re-add is exact rollback.
test_case.expected_result: The single exact delete returns completion 00h and the selected non-wildcard Record ID. A full post-delete search cannot retrieve the target content; record count decreases by exactly one, capacity changes consistently, and every unrelated pre-delete record remains present by content fingerprint even if its Record ID changed. No clear/erase occurs, BMC/SEL health remains stable and the immutable before/request/after audit is retained. Unsupported Delete is capability-backed N/A; reservation cancellation, wrong returned ID, target still present, more than one missing content record, untracked new event, erase/overflow state or evidence failure is FAIL/NOT READY without retry.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact Source Key/variant, advertised Delete support, current reservation, exact non-0000/non-FFFF disposable target, immutable full export/hash, fresh target confirmation, one correct 0Ah/46h request, returned-ID equality and complete content-based post-delete reconciliation. Bare 0Ah/46h, first/last aliases, genuine fault deletion, command success alone, SEL clear, OOB evidence substituted for this IB identity, record-ID-only neighbor comparison, automatic retry, guessed re-add/rollback or missing preserved evidence cannot pass. N/A requires authoritative Delete-unsupported evidence.
safety_gate: Use only the local interface for this IB identity; row 1199 OOB and row 1073 Clear SEL remain separate and cannot satisfy this case.
The target is disposable, synthetic and uniquely identifiable. Any uncertainty that it represents a real fault, audit or compliance record makes the run NOT READY.
Export and hash the complete SEL plus target details before reservation. No pre-test clear, log deletion or evidence mutation is permitted.
Use a fresh reservation and re-read the exact target immediately before confirmation. Never use 0000h/Ffffh aliases; abort if a concurrent event cancels the reservation or changes target content.
One delete only after immediate irreversible-action confirmation. Stop on any completion/returned-ID/reconciliation anomaly and preserve both snapshots.
No automatic retry and no claimed exact rollback. Unexpected loss is escalated to the evidence/SEL owner; do not clear, re-add guessed bytes, reset BMC or delete another entry.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/variant; BMC/firmware/local-interface identity; official delete/reservation authority; distinct row-1199 OOB and row-1073 Clear identities
Raw Get SEL Info support/health, complete pre-delete raw+decoded export and hashes, exact disposable target ID/content/provenance and deletion reason
Reserve response, fresh full target read/hash, timestamped immediate confirmation and redacted four-byte 0Ah/46h request/completion/returned ID
Complete post-delete export and content-fingerprint reconciliation proving only the target vanished, with count/capacity/timestamp and concurrent-event accounting
Protected immutable audit package, BMC/SEL health and any unsupported/N/A authority or anomaly escalation
Engineer PASS/FAIL/NOT READY/N/A verdict explicitly recording irreversibility, no retry and no DUT action by the review agent
test_case.recovery: Deletion is intentionally irreversible and cannot be exactly restored because Record ID and possibly timestamp would change. Recovery is therefore preventive: delete only a disposable synthetic record after immutable full export and final confirmation. If the reservation is canceled before deletion, send nothing and record FAIL/NOT READY without reacquiring. If the wrong or additional content disappears, stop, preserve before/after exports and command audit, isolate further SEL writers and escalate to the platform/evidence owner. Do not clear SEL, delete another record, cold-reset, automatically retry or claim that re-adding reconstructed bytes restores the original.

source_conflict.reason: Official section 31.8 resolves the missing payload and reservation semantics: the review layer replaces bare 0Ah/46h and pre-clear behavior with an exact four-byte single-record delete and immutable reconciliation, without editing Master history.

blocked.reason: Delete capability, reservation, record-ID encoding, completion and response are standardized. Exact disposable target, export, quiet window and authorization are bounded Project execution inputs.

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1 E7
external_authorities.application: Sections 31.2, 31.4-31.5 and 31.8/Tables 31-2, 31-4, 31-5 and 31-8 define Delete/Reserve support bits, reservation/cancellation, exact little-endian reservation and record-ID payload, first/last aliases, returned deleted ID and full-record readback.

project_authority: SEL/evidence owners select and attest the disposable target, preserve the entire repository, approve the exact irreversible action after fresh identity verification, control concurrency and own anomaly response/verdicts. They cannot approve real fault deletion, wildcard first/last, full clear, missing export, automatic retry, guessed rollback or substitution of the OOB/Clear cases.
